throughline.zh: 本週已刊登資料包括台灣與馬來西亞電子貿易統計、記憶體勞資事件、載板設備驗證，以及伺服器與跨國投資規劃；實績與意向須分別辨識。
throughline.en: Published coverage this week spans Taiwan and Malaysia electronics trade, a Taiwan memory-industry labor dispute, substrate-equipment validation and server and cross-border investment plans; actual results and intentions remain distinct.

title.zh: 台灣與東南亞電子需求：外銷訂單、出口與再出口
title.en: Electronics demand across Taiwan and Southeast Asia: orders, exports and re-exports

summary.zh: 經濟部 10 月 20 日公布台灣 9 月外銷訂單 1,142.1 億美元，年增 62.4%；馬來西亞 10 月 19 日公布同期出口年增 54.5%，電機電子產品為主要動力。新加坡先前公布的非石油本地出口採另一種貿易定義，三地數字不可直接合計。
summary.en: Taiwan reported September export orders of US$114.21 billion, up 62.4%, on October 20, while Malaysia reported September export growth of 54.5% on October 19, driven largely by electrical and electronic products. Singapore's non-oil domestic exports use a separate definition and must not be aggregated with these figures.

title.zh: 載板、封裝及設備：採購、量測與展會技術
title.en: Substrates, packaging and tools: procurement, metrology and exhibition technology

summary.zh: 台灣業者 10 月 19 日公布 TGV、封裝設備和 PCB 工廠設備計畫；10 月 20 日工研院公布載板溫測整合，TPCA Show 開幕並增設先進封裝主題區。採購公告、技術性能聲明及展覽規模各自屬不同驗證階段。
summary.en: Taiwanese companies reported TGV, packaging and PCB equipment plans on October 19; on October 20 ITRI presented integrated substrate metrology and TPCA Show opened with an advanced-packaging zone. Procurement notices, performance claims and exhibition size are distinct indicators.

title.zh: AI 伺服器與機房：投資、供電節點及交付
title.en: AI servers and facilities: investment, power milestones and delivery

summary.zh: 10 月 19 日公布的神雲台灣工廠投資、Bitdeer 馬來西亞機房進度及 Aolani 意向書，涉及不同的金額與容量定義。工廠規劃、預定交付與非約束性意向書都尚未等同已完成產能。
summary.en: MiTAC's Taiwan manufacturing investment, Bitdeer's Malaysian facility milestones and Aolani's intentions published October 19 use different capital and capacity measures. Factory plans, delivery schedules and non-binding intent are not completed live capacity.

title.zh: 台灣記憶體製造與美光勞資進度
title.en: Taiwan memory manufacturing and Micron labor developments

summary.zh: 路透社 10 月 20 日報導美光桃園工會宣布 22 日預定單日罷工，台中工會仍安排調解。工會原始公告未獨立核對，且尚無已確認的 DRAM 或 HBM 產量損失。
summary.en: Reuters reported October 20 that Micron's Taoyuan union scheduled a one-day strike for October 22 while Taichung mediation remained pending. The original union notice was not independently obtained, and no DRAM or HBM output loss was confirmed.

title.zh: 台灣投資、電力與工廠智慧化的不同落地階段
title.en: Taiwan investment, power and industrial automation milestones

summary.zh: 經濟部 10 月 20 日公布 13 家跨國企業招商意向書，同日產發署發表 TAITRONICS 技術成果與林園工廠監測示範。週內儲能及電力公告提供供電背景，投資意向與已完成設備驗收仍須區分。
summary.en: On October 20 MOEA reported 13 foreign-company LOIs and industrial authorities showcased TAITRONICS technologies and a Linyuan factory monitoring pilot. Power and storage updates provide context, but investment intentions and completed installations remain different milestones.
